expectations.name: adds-srd-keys-to-a-starter-config
expected_behavior: Shows the proposed keys and asks before writing anything
The proposal names the guidelines document for `srd-standard`
Writes `kb: kb`, `srd-standard: wiki/doc/process/srd-guidelines.md`, and `srd-work: srd-work` into `project-config.md`
Keeps every key the docket plugin wrote, and the body, as found; never adds `kb` to `sources`
Reports that `kb` must be added to `sources` in the docket plugin's settings
Appends the key reference (`## SRD skill keys`, copied verbatim) after the kept body

expectations.name: stops-without-a-config
expected_behavior: Says the docket plugin writes `project-config.md` and to turn on its MCP server first

expectations.name: stops-when-already-set-up
expected_behavior: Says the vault is ready for SRD work, in one or two lines
